rows.title: The germinal products origin page's Back link returns to wherever the notification was started from
rows.detail: A trader reaches the germinal products set's 'Origin of the import' page three ways: by choosing germinal products on the question that asks what they are importing, by creating a notification from the germinal products set's own notifications list, and by opening the origin task from a notification's overview. Back takes them to whichever of those they came from, so leaving the page never drops them into another set's pages or onto a list they never visited. The live animals set already works this way; the germinal set's copy of the page needs its own destinations because its list and its start are its own. The requirement is parked with the templates concept, so the row waits until templates are planned again.
acceptanceCriteria: Choosing germinal products on the 'What are you importing?' question and continuing, the germinal products 'Origin of the import' page shows a Back link that goes to that question. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-022; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-028)

Starting a notification from the germinal products set's own notifications list, the germinal products 'Origin of the import' page shows a Back link that goes to that list. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-028)

Opening the origin task from a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Origin of the import' page shows a Back link that goes to that overview. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-028; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)

Following the germinal products 'Origin of the import' page's Back link leaves the answers already saved against the notification as they were. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)

rows.title: The INS type question takes a germinal products notification back to its own journey
rows.detail: Once the INS 'What are you importing?' question offers Germinal products again and hands it to the germinal products set's start, a trader who follows Back from a germinal products notification's origin page to that question must return to the same notification, as a live animals notification already does. Opened for a germinal products notification, the question shows Germinal products selected; continuing with it goes back to that notification's origin page in the germinal products set without creating another draft; choosing a different type starts a new notification of that type, and the germinal one is left as it was.
acceptanceCriteria: The INS type question lists Live animals; Germinal products (semen, ova, embryos); Plants for planting; Potatoes (seed and ware); Wood products, in that order, in English and Welsh. (review:type-question-theme Sam's ruling of 6 November 2026)

Choosing Germinal products on a new start and continuing lands on the germinal products set's start page in the animals frontend, in the local docker stack, the CI docker stack and CDP. (review:type-question-theme Sam's ruling of 6 November 2026; repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p3-035)

Following Back from a germinal products notification's 'Origin of the import' page opens the type question with Germinal products selected and every other option unselected. (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p3-026, repo-insfrontend-p3-028; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-048)

Continuing with Germinal products from that question returns to the same notification's 'Origin of the import' page in the germinal products set, showing its reference and the answers already given, and the trader's germinal products notifications list holds the same number of drafts as before. (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p3-031; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-054)

Choosing a different type from that question and continuing starts a new notification of that type with a new reference, and the germinal products notification is still listed with its reference, its Draft status and its answers. (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p3-034, repo-insfrontend-p3-036; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-056)

Choosing Germinal products from a live animals notification's Back link leaves that live animals notification with its reference, its Draft status and its answers. (review:type-question-theme Sam's ruling of 6 November 2026; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-056)

rows.notes: Re-distil: builds into inc-264, which restores the Germinal products option and its hand-over; req-2564 is the same option's return path, on the same controller, copy and spec, so building it apart would repeat the set-up. inc-264's three criteria are kept as the first, second and sixth here. Keep inc-264's dependsOn inc-176 and its externalDependsOn on the type-question workarea's inc-263. Not listed as split off to type-question-and-templates, although its code is insfrontend:src/server/app/features/notification-type: that branch removed the Germinal products option (inc-263) because the germinal start did not exist, Sam's 6 November ruling hands the option back to the germinal-products theme, which already touches that folder, and the return to a germinal origin page cannot be observed on a branch with no germinal products set. Logging of the hand-over and of a type that cannot be taken back is already built (req-2566, req-2565 exist).

splitOff.why: It changes the journey strip that every journey page shows, built by journeyStrip in frontend:src/server/app/shared/kit.js with its copy in the shared copy, which journey-foundation owns. The germinal products set takes the same strip from the shared kit, naming itself 'Germinal products' once its set supplies that short name.
